issues.on_page: Fees and services 253,663 (Utility Fund operating receipts)
issues.issue: Utility fund sales/charges have their own receipt category Utility Charges; the matching detail line (detail[21]) already uses Utility Charges, so the two are inconsistent

The Statement of Activities (pp2-3) implies Local = fees and charges 15,708 + capital grants and contributions not counted as intergovernmental about 138,223 (489,599 less the 351,376 gap between fund-statement Intergovernmental 483,826 and general-receipts Intergovernmental 132,450) + miscellaneous income 7,418. Capital grants/contributions are more than half of the line, so donations/contributions might fit better than other. The user's category decision is recorded on the line, so this is left for review
